list.title: Seoul first trip essentials
list.desc: A free starter map made by PinWith for r/koreatravel members: getting in from the airport, SIM and T-money, a 24h pharmacy and the classic first-trip sights. Copy it and make it your own.

items.title: AREX Travel Service Center (Seoul Station)
items.memo: Airport Railroad desk at Seoul Station; express train to/from Incheon takes about 45 min

items.title: Travel Depot (Hongik Univ. Stn)
items.memo: Prepaid SIMs and currency exchange near Hongik Univ. Station exit 3; open daily

items.title: CU convenience store (Gwanghwamun)
items.memo: Convenience stores sell and top up T-money cards; refunds keep a small fee
items.check: refund availability varies by store; based on a single review

items.title: Myeongdong Mega Pharmacy
items.memo: Pharmacy listed as open 24 hours in Myeongdong; English-speaking staff reported

items.title: Gyeongbokgung Palace (경복궁)
items.memo: Closed Tuesdays; entry is free if you wear hanbok; guard ceremony in the morning

items.title: Bukchon Hanok Village (북촌한옥마을)
items.memo: Lived-in neighbourhood: visit 10:00-17:00 and keep noise down

items.title: Gwangjang Market (광장시장)
items.memo: Old market for bindaetteok, gimbap and street snacks; clean toilets on site

items.title: Myeongdong shopping street (명동)
items.memo: K-beauty shops and street-food stalls; Myeongdong Station (Line 4)

items.title: Olive Young Myeongdong Town
items.memo: Big two-floor Olive Young; tax refund at the counter; open 10:00-22:30

items.title: Hongdae street (홍대)
items.memo: Buskers, shops and nightlife around Hongik Univ. Station (Line 2/AREX)

items.title: Yeouido Hangang Park (여의도한강공원)
items.memo: Han River picnic spot; mat and bike rentals, convenience-store ramyeon, open 24h
